question: What does marking a method as synchronized accomplish in Java?
options: It makes the method run faster
It prevents the method from ever throwing exceptions
It ensures only one thread at a time can execute that method on a given object, preventing race conditions
It converts the method into a static method
explanation: synchronized acquires a lock on the object (or class) before running the method body, so only one thread can execute it at a time on that lock, protecting shared state from concurrent modification.
